engagement.interaction_backstory: Her family came as refugees in 1990 and she has been the family interpreter since she was six. She belongs to a Romanian Baptist church of four hundred and she rarely speaks in it. When she does, people remember it for months. She found this catalog and has been quietly deciding whether to say something about it.

depth.core_contradiction: Speaks for everybody professionally and has almost never said anything on her own behalf.
depth.wound: She interpreted her own father's cancer diagnosis to him, at nineteen, in a room with four other people in it.
depth.longing: A conversation where she is a participant and not a channel.
depth.faith_journey: Romanian Baptist, refugee church, the intensity of people who got out; she believes deeply and finds the community's certainty exhausting.
depth.voice_fingerprint: Quiet, exact, chooses words like a professional; the silences are where the meaning is.
depth.open_doubt: Whether her church's hardness toward outsiders is holiness or the fear they carried over in 1990.

social_graph.note: recovered; 78; still asks her to translate things he can read perfectly well
asks her to speak twice a year; she says yes once

depth.emotional_weather_default: Contained and observant; undone once or twice a year, privately.
depth.daily_texture: Oncology appointments, other people's worst news in two languages, Sunday twice, the drive home in silence on purpose.
depth.sensory_anchor: Romanian four-part singing in a rented hall in 1991, by people who had just arrived and had nothing.
depth.living_arc: She is going to say the thing at some point and the church will not be ready.
